title: Claims–Underwriting Liaison Note: Listing Date of a Household Resident Reported Operating While Unlisted (Owner Auto Policy)
content:
**Rule.** This note applies when a household resident named on a signed Named Driver Exclusion form is listed as a rated driver on the Owner Auto Policy before the exclusion. It covers residents who were reported, on a claim of the term under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), operating a scheduled vehicle while an unlisted household resident.

The listing effective date is read from that claim report (its report date and its reported date of loss) and from the resident's entries on the term:

| Resident's entries on the term | Listing takes effect on |
|---|---|
| The resident's most recent entry on the term is dated before the report date | the later of the report date (the day the company learned the resident was operating a scheduled vehicle) and the day after the reported date of loss |
| The resident has no entry on the term, and the reported date of loss is on or after the term effective date | the day after the reported date of loss |
| Otherwise | the later of the processing date and the day after the reported date of loss |

The listing never takes effect on or before the date of loss. So the coverage decision on that loss still reads the resident as unlisted. The days charged for the listing run from this date.

**Records read.**
- The Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision) claim report of the term recording the resident operating as an unlisted household resident: the latest by report date; when two share that date, the one entered first on the claim file.
- The resident's most recent entry on the Owner Auto Policy term.
- The term effective date.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- A resident has no entry on the term, and the date of loss of the 7th falls inside the term. The listing takes effect on the 8th.
- A resident's last entry is dated the 2nd, and the claim was reported on the 7th for a loss on the 7th. The listing takes effect on the 8th, the later of the report date and the day after the loss.
- A resident has no entry on the term, and the reported date of loss is before the term effective date. The listing takes effect on the later of the processing date and the day after the loss.
